Meta.title: Causius — understand and answer legal letters
Meta.description: Causius reads an official letter with you: what it says, what it asks for and by when. When you need a person, it hands the case to a legal assistant or a licensed lawyer.

Footer.tagline: The legal layer of the fleet: an agent that does the legal work, and a person who decides.
Footer.disclaimer: Beta: running, not released. Causius gives legal information, not legal advice. Only a lawyer admitted where your matter is may advise you on it or represent you.
Footer.openSource: Open source under the MIT licence. Built in Zürich.

Settings.metaDescription: Use your own AI model for Causius analyses.
Settings.title: Settings
Settings.p1: Without a key, Causius reads letters with free shared models. They have a small daily budget that every visitor draws on, and they are not the strongest available.
Settings.p2: A legal letter deserves the best reading you can give it. Connect an API key from a provider below and your analyses run on the strongest model that key can use, on your own budget. The key is kept in this browser only: it is sent with each analysis to reach your provider and is never stored by Causius.
Settings.p3: Use an API key, ideally one with a spending cap. Causius never asks for a subscription login such as Claude Pro or ChatGPT Plus.

Platform.metaDescription: The architecture of Causius: an agent that does legal work on a sealed case file, with every personal detail hidden from the models it uses.
Platform.title: How Causius is built, and why
Platform.lede: Legal work is slow because it is done by hand. Causius is an agent that does the work and a person who decides, built so what it handles stays private and what it claims can be checked.

why.title: Why build it
why.p1: Most legal trouble is a letter with a deadline, a form or a contract: work with clear rules, billed by the hour because nobody automated it.
why.p3: So Causius is a case file with an agent attached, not a chat. Lawyers stay where the law puts them; the rest gets done.

capabilities.title: What is real today
capabilities.lede: Each line says whether it works. The roadmap and changelog are public.

identity.title: Identity and money

Security.metaDescription: How Causius keeps legal matters private: anonymisation before any model, per-matter encryption at rest, a locked-down browser and approvals only the owner can give.
Security.title: Private by construction
Security.lede: Causius handles legal letters. Each guarantee below is a property of the public code. None asks you to trust us.

anon.title: Models are not told who
anon.body: Before text goes to a model, personal details become placeholders, restored only after the answer returns. Detection is good, not perfect: check what is hidden.
anon.d1: Found automatically: names, addresses, postcodes, emails, phone numbers, IBANs, AHV numbers, references, birth dates.
anon.d2: Your own words to hide are always added.
anon.d3: In the quick check this happens in your browser.
anon.d4: Web searches go out with placeholders too.
anon.d5: The exception is your voice: a recording goes to a speech service and cannot be hidden first. Causius does not store it, and typing never involves it.

sealed.title: Sealed at rest
sealed.body: Each matter has its own data key, sealed by a master key that is never in the database.
sealed.d1: AES-256-GCM, a fresh nonce per value, bound to its matter and purpose.
sealed.d2: Titles, messages, facts, deadlines, decisions and document text are sealed; only dates, statuses, sizes and the jurisdiction code are clear.
sealed.d3: Without the master key, a copy of the database is noise.

minimal.title: Nothing kept that is not needed
minimal.body: An upload is reduced to its text. A letter checked without an account is not stored.
minimal.d1: No users table, no passwords: only an OrangeCat account id.
minimal.d2: Logs record which model served a turn, never what was said. No analytics. The only extra script is the optional feedback widget.

browser.title: A locked-down browser
browser.body: Every page carries a strict content security policy.
browser.d1: Scripts run only with a per-request nonce, and a page may talk to Causius and nothing else.

access.title: Only you decide
access.body: A matter opens only for the people in it. Anyone else gets the answer a missing matter gets.
access.d1: Actions that leave the matter are proposals only its owner can approve.
access.d2: Limits per account protect the shared models.
access.d3: Deleting a matter deletes all of it.

breach.title: If it went wrong
breach.lede: What each party would hold if the worst happened.

database.title: A stolen database
database.body: Ciphertext, account ids and dates. No names, no letters. Deadline dates are readable.

provider.title: A model provider's logs
provider.body: Placeholders where the people were: [NAME-1], living at [ADDRESS-1].

operator.title: Us, the operator
operator.body: We run the server holding the master key, so we could be compelled. Keys only you hold are on the roadmap; until then, that is the honest limit.

Ecosystem.metaDescription: Causius is the legal layer of a fleet of products — OrangeCat, Loki and Solon — that one OrangeCat account opens.
Ecosystem.title: One person, a whole fleet
Ecosystem.lede: Causius is one product in a fleet built to give a single person what used to take an institution. Each product does one job, and one OrangeCat account opens them all.
Ecosystem.unavailable: The list of products could not be loaded just now. Try again in a minute.
Ecosystem.layerBody: OrangeCat moves value, Loki gets the work done and Solon governs. Causius is the legal layer on top: the matters, registrations and contracts through which a person or an organisation exists in law and keeps its word. Solon holds the law as data; Causius does the legal work with it.

build.title: Built and shipped by Loki

law.title: The law, from Solon
law.body: Solon keeps rules as versioned data and decisions as signed votes. Causius will cite the law from it, rule by rule.

account.title: One account for all of it
account.body: Create it once at OrangeCat and use it for Causius, OrangeCat, Solon and Loki.
